summary: The error screen: 'That did not load' with Reload, Go to Tonight, what the app saw, and the bug report form as a panel; the form extracted from its dialog into one shared implementation (checked line by line: no behaviour change; the dialog's tests untouched); the update notice still outside the boundary. Lows-only on the first pass. Queued: the description limit counted in characters where the server counts bytes; a send that lands during a dismissal not reported as sent; switch sentences that can be stale; the closure line hidden from assistive technology; collected text reaching the tracker as live markdown; nothing guarding the screen against its own errors; session changes heard through storage only.
